stories.title: More than 600 foreigners listed as missing following floods in Nepal — police
stories.summary: NEW DELHI, September 3. At least 601 foreign nationals are listed as missing following floods and a landslide in Nepal, the country’s police reported. "The total number of those missing stands at 4,875, including 2,924 Nepalese citizens and 601 foreigners," police said. According to the latest data, as many as 1,252 people died. A flood struck northern Nepal on August 26, caused by an avalanche on the border with China, about 20 kilometers northeast of the Rasuwagadhi border crossing. A powerful flow of water, dirt and rocks rushed over 70 kilometers down a river, destroying nearby settlements and flooding a large territory.

stories.title: Tunisia's top court set to rule in ‘conspiracy against the state’ case
stories.summary: In Tunisia, the Court of Cassation is set to issue its final ruling in the “conspiracy against the state” case. In April 2025, 37 people – most of them prominent political figures opposed to President Kais Saied – were sentenced to prison in connection with the case. Several human rights organisations have condemned the trial as unjust and called for the release of all political detainees. The appeal represents the defendants’ last legal avenue to overturn their convictions, according to a press release from Amnesty International. But defence lawyers and the detainees’ families remain pessimistic, as FRANCE 24’s Lilia Blaise reports.

stories.headline: 21 men, including private tutors, arrested for possessing child porn, unlawful filming

opening: Hong Kong police have arrested 21 men for possession of child pornography and upskirt images, with the arrestees including private tutors accused of surreptitiously filming their students during classes.

Superintendent Wong Yick-lung of Kowloon East regional headquarters for crime said on Thursday that officers had uncovered a social media chat group containing child pornography, as well as upskirt images taken on public transport and in shopping centres, that could be downloaded.

stories.title: In an art gallery far, far away: George Lucas unveils art galaxy at new LA museum
stories.summary: George Lucas, the legendary creator of the "Star Wars" saga, on Wednesday showcased his long-awaited Museum of Narrative Art, the culmination of nearly two decades of work and numerous obstacles. "I'm used to doing the impossible. This one almost broke my will," Lucas said as he offered reporters a first glimpse inside, ahead of the museum's official opening on September 22. Lucas, 82, has described the complex built with his wife and business partner, Mellody Hobson, as the "people's temple of art."
